topic: Prebiotics vs probiotics — feeding your gut bacteria
caption: Did you know your gut has its own 'food' preferences? 🍎 Learn how prebiotics and probiotics can transform your gut health! 💪 Prebiotics are non-digestible fibers that feed your good bacteria, while probiotics are live bacteria that add to the existing gut flora. 🌱 Studies show that a combination of both can boost your immune system and even produce vitamins! 🧬 Save this so you don't lose it.
